activities.title: Listen to the music lesson. Write a word in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: Oliver (profesor por un día) y Maya (alumna de guitarra).
data.script: Oliver: Guitar lesson one, Maya! First rule: hold the guitar carefully, like a baby penguin. … Maya: A baby penguin. Okay… … Oliver: Now play the first note slowly. Slooowly. … Maya: Like this? … Oliver: Perfect! Now the same note quickly. … Maya: Oh! It sounds happier when it's fast! … Oliver: Exactly! Fast notes laugh, slow notes dream. … Maya: And loud notes? … Oliver: Loud notes shout! But play quietly at home, or your neighbours will visit you angrily. … Maya: Science has formulas, music has adverbs!
